title: School Photo Link
scenario: A link says your school photos are ready but asks for social media login first.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: School Photo Link: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Photo services do not need your social media password.
